metadata.title: Singular Loci of SL2(C)-Representation Varieties of Torus Knot Groups
metadata.abstract: Let $T(q,p)=\langle x,y\mid x^p=y^q\rangle$, where $p,q>1$ are relatively prime, and let \[ R=\Hom(T(q,p),\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb C)). \] We compute the integral homology of the singular locus of $R$. We show that this locus has complex dimension $2$ and is a disjoint union of $\mu=(p-1)(q-1)$ smooth affine surfaces, each homotopy equivalent to the two-dimensional sphere. Consequently, \[ H_0(\Sing R;\Z)\cong H_2(\Sing R;\Z)\cong\Z^\mu, \] and all remaining homology groups vanish. Thus both nonzero Betti numbers equal the first Betti number of the Milnor fiber of the plane curve singularity $z^p+w^q=0$, namely its Milnor number $\mu$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 计算互素参数环面结群的 SL₂(C) 表示簇之奇异集的整系数同调。
analysis.breakthrough: 将奇异集描述为 μ=(p−1)(q−1) 个光滑仿射曲面的不交并，各同伦于 S²，从而 H₀、H₂ 均为 Z^μ。
analysis.limitations: 计算的是表示簇的奇异子集，不是整个表示簇或角色簇的同调；参数要求 p,q>1 且互素。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者详细披露 ChatGPT 用于数学讨论、提出论证的发展审查、计算代码、定理证明和文字的多轮草拟修订及 LaTeX；未具体逐项归因核心发现。SageMath/GAP 等软件调查本身不作为 AI 证据。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.32064v1 · PDF 第 1 页工具说明
